response.overview: Mina forms a study group, but whenever she feels a strange distance growing between herself and her friends, she quietly pulls away. She does not clearly understand what the feeling is.  As she comes face to face with each friend, Mina begins to realize that they, too, see strengths in her that she has never recognized in herself.  Without directly naming the emotion, the film explores the vague feelings that make us feel small, redefining them through different words, relationships, and emotional shades.
response.title: Scent of colors
